rules.label: Posts and reels from accounts you don't follow

verified: 2026-09-24 live DOM, home feed: every sponsored article (6/6) carried a link to facebook.com/ads/ig_redirect; no organic article did. The 'Sponsored' label is not a stable element, and usernames are links, so author links are ignored as labels. Suggested (live, English UI): articles no longer have a <header>; a post or reel from an account you don't follow shows 'Suggested for you' as a span and a div[role=button] reading exactly 'Follow' near the top. The people carousel ('Suggested for you', See all -> /explore/people/, Follow buttons) sits outside any article; the smallest div holding that link and a button is the module. Dutch, German and French strings are baseline guesses, UNVERIFIED live.
